items.quote: The reason I’m asking is simple: I receive countless inquiries about training agents and collaborating with companies.
items.statement: I receive countless inquiries about training agents and collaborating with companies.

items.quote: Unfortunately, I haven’t figured out how to clone myself yet (working on it!), and that means I can’t personally take on every opportunity.
items.statement: I can’t personally take on every opportunity but can help others who dream of becoming sales trainers.

items.quote: But what I can do is help others who dream of becoming sales trainers themselves.
items.statement: I’m thinking of launching a coaching program for agents who want to transition into a training role.

items.quote: But isn’t sure how to: - Start as a trainer, - Build effective training programs, - Teach others how to sell.
items.statement: Teach others how to sell by building effective training programs.

items.quote: So, tell me: Would you be interested in a career shift that allows you to stay in the industry, share your knowledge, and help others succeed in real estate sales?
items.statement: Tell me if you’d be interested in a career shift that allows you to stay in the industry, share your knowledge, and help others succeed.

overview: LinkedIn post inviting agents to consider becoming sales trainers in real estate, highlighting training opportunities.
